world.title: Poland & Latvia at Center of Tourism Strategy for Municipality of Aristotelis, Halkidiki
world.description: HALKIDIKI – A program of business meetings between representatives of the Municipality of Aristotelis and travel agencies in Krakow took place on August 19 with the aim of further strengthening the presence of Eastern Halkidiki in the Polish tourism market. The meetings focused on travel agencies, which implement holiday programs of important Polish tour operators, such as Grecos, Coral Travel, and Itaka, constituting key links in the promotion and distribution of the region's tourism product. A total of four professional contacts were held, during which the "marine" potential of the coastal zone of the Municipality of Aristotelis was mainly presented. Particular emphasis was given to the promotion of Ammouliani , which can be an ideal holiday destination for Polish visitors seeking experiences in an island environment.
